title: Left Luggage
pitch: A kid sleeping rough in the yard was minding a bag for Lucas. Strangers came asking, and now he won't answer. Get the bag.

clue_a.label: The boxcar
lines: Blankets, a camping stove, a coach timetable. The coast coach is circled twice. He's planning to run.

clue_b.label: The van
lines: Lucas's holdall, wedged under the seat of the burned-out van. Tape still on. He hasn't opened it.
